‘Umar ibn al-Khattāb (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: One day, we were sitting with the Messenger of Allah (may Allah’s peace and blessings be upon him) when there appeared before us a man … "That was Jibrīl, who came to teach you your religion.”

شرح الحديث :

Jibrīl (peace be upon him) once appeared as an unknown man before the Companions …
